params.body:
The Capture the Flag of Saturday 14 November 2026 has taken place, and `/communities/cybersec` still announced it. This turns the event block into a recap, in en, nl and fr.

## What changes

- **Recap instead of announcement.** 18 participants, 30 challenges (12 Easy, 12 Medium, 6 Hard) themed on The Gambia, the seven topics, individual play in two rankings (Beginner and Experienced), own laptop with a Linux machine and an AI tutor, a certificate for everyone. No player names and no photos.
- **No register box, no number.** The box, the encoded contact number and the script that decoded it are removed from the page, together with the build-time and in-browser date switch that hid them after the day. `src/lib/contact.js` and the `check:built` step stay, so the built site is still checked for the number.
- **How to join.** A short "The next event" box points to info@kubo.global.
- **Alpha Omar Bah** is shown as lead of KUBO CyberSec, in place of the team-page role.
- **Poster.** Kept as the picture of the day, captioned as the poster that announced it, without the download link.
- **Metadata.** The meta description reports the event in the past tense. The Event JSON-LD drops the offer and the hours.

## Checked

- `npm test`: 25 tests pass.
- `npm run build`, then `npm run check:built`: 80 text files, no contact number.
- A grep of `dist` for the encoded form, the reveal button, `tel:` and `wa.me` finds nothing.
- Looked at in a browser at 390 px (en, nl, fr) and at 1440 px (en).

## Not in this pull request

- The card on `/communities` still says "starting with a Capture the Flag on 14 November 2026", which reads correctly after the event as well.
- The "What it is" card still mentions working in teams. It describes the community, not this event.
params.title: CyberSec page: recap of the first Capture the Flag
